story.title: Zayd's counting my BLESSINGS series.
paragraphs_en: Zayd is happy as he can be, spending his holiday with his grandparents in Nigeria for the first time is so much FUN and he loves it. He enjoys singing his favorite song as he plays in the garden with his grandpa. But it is now time for bed and Zayd is not ready!

"Zayd, can I have the butterfly jar, so you can get ready for bed.?" Grandpa says. "No, I want to get more" Zayd says pleading. Grandpa smiles warmly and says "when your grandma calls, you have to go in to take a bath."
"Got it" Zayd says as he flee away thinking about getting some ladybugs. "How fun will itnbe to get some ladybugs in the jar...Oh!! Maa shaa Allah!" And he ran back to the field.
"AlhamduliLaah I have my hands" "AlhamduliLaah I have my grandpa" "AlhamduliLaah am having fun" "AlhamduliLaah I got some ladybugs!" Zayd sings with excitement as he tries to catch some ladybugs .

"Zayd!!" Grandma calls out. "What are you doing out there, it is late." Grandma added. "I am counting my BLESSINGS" Zayd shouted back happily. 'AlhamduliLaah I have you Grandma" he says shouting behind the garden.
"I am just not ready for bed" Zayd says to himself. "Thank you Zayd, AlhamduliLaah!, I am grateful for having you too. But it is time for bed" Grandma calls out.

"I wonder why the insects come out only in the evening?" Zayd asks. "It is not so late Zayd, but you need to sleep early because you have a long flight tomorrow InShaa Allah" Grandpa tells him. "Oh, I do not want to go BACK" Zayd cries,"It is beautiful here"

"AlhamduliLaah I have my eyes" "AlhamduliLaah I can see" "AlhamduliLaah I have my legs" "AlhamduliLaah I can walk" "But I am not ready to go back" Zayd sings quietly, as he is trying to hide from his grandparents.
"Come here Zayd, you need to get a bath NOW. " Grandpa says But, Zayd is not ready to go into the house or back to New York where he comes from. Zayd just wants to have FUN and count his blessings.

"In Shaa Allah, you and your cousins would come to Nigeria for Eid. Now you need to go back for school" Grandpa tells Zayd after he found him from where he was hiding. "really!!!" his eyes light up and he jumps for joy. "ALHAMDULILAAH I have you Grandpa, you are the best!" Zayd is now happy and ready for bed.
